_doc: Traits unlock when personality stats cross thresholds (every entry in 'unlock' must hold) and stay unlocked. Personality runs on two axes (Charisma <-> Intelligence, Ambition <-> Leadership; see the scenario data): each single-stat trait rewards leaning one way, and each combo pairs one stat from each axis. 'passive' is the small bonus: 'profile' adds to KickProfile fields (same keys as modifiers.json effects); 'gains' multiplies stat gains, keyed by a group (life/football/personality) or a single stat (e.g. resilience), +0.15 = 15% bigger gains; 'miss_streak' scales how much a miss streak adds to pressure (-0.3 = 30% less). 'unlocks' is shown on the Stats & Traits screen; scenarios name the traits they require.
